summary: Seven-mode state machine (mode selector at this+0x1C) that loads or unloads a scene object. Modes 0-5 call sub_45A8E0 against the position buffer at this+0xC to decide between a clear path (CameraShakeRingBufferWrite + sub_4BDE20, return 0) and a keep path (sub_4BDE20, return the check result). Mode 6 gates VehiclePhysicsModeDispatcher on bit 8 of the sub-object vtable entry at (*(this+0x20)+0x0)+0x48BC, runs SuspensionStateUpdate on the sub-object, copies its position triple at +0x34D4/0x34D8/0x34DC into this+0xC/0x10/0x14, then returns 1.

sub_45A8E0(a2, position pointer this+0xC) checks sub-object status; the result routes each mode to the clear or keep path.
Clear path: CameraShakeRingBufferWrite(this) then sub_4BDE20(this); returns 0.
Keep path (LABEL_12): sub_4BDE20(this); returns the sub_45A8E0 result.
Mode 6: bit 8 of the vtable entry at (*(this+0x20)+0x0)+0x48BC gates VehiclePhysicsModeDispatcher.
VehiclePhysicsModeDispatcher(a2) when the vtable gate bit is set.
SuspensionStateUpdate on the sub-object pointer held at this+0x20.
Copy the sub-object position triple at +0x34D4/0x34D8/0x34DC into this+0xC/0x10/0x14.
Mode 6 returns 1 after sub_4BDE20; other modes return the check result or 0.
